subject.title: fix(browser): use public ssrf runtime import in CDP proxy bypass

question: Should `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` and the configured local-origin SSRF helpers remain private owner-scoped Browser/Ollama helpers, or may they be promoted into public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/ssrf-runtime`?
rationale: The current PR cannot be made correct by a one-line import change: keeping the helper private requires a package/alias repair, while making the public import valid changes the Plugin SDK security boundary.

options.title: Preserve Owner-Scoped Helper Access
options.body: Keep the helper private and fix the packaged Browser/Ollama lazy-load path through the existing private alias or staging mechanism.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Promotion
options.body: Allow the helper to move into public `ssrf-runtime` only with explicit SDK/security approval, docs/API metadata, guardrails, and smoke proof.

options.title: Choose A Canonical Replacement
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers choose a sibling PR or a new branch as the canonical repair for the linked regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve Owner-Scoped Helper Access
recommendation.body: Keep the helper private and fix the packaged Browser/Ollama lazy-load path through the existing private alias or staging mechanism.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses package exports, private SDK classification, and prior Browser/Ollama private-boundary merge history where this person is the strongest routing signal.
